note: Exam formats shown on /delf-dalf (DELF and DALF). Rewritten 11 November 2026 from public information of France Éducation international. Structure only; no exam content is reproduced. Every figure is 'to verify' (reports/exams-delf-dalf.md).

formate.source: public exam information from France Éducation international (france-education-international.fr, DELF-DALF pages), checked on 11 November 2026. Treat timings and numbers of exercises as a guide and check the current official exam guide before you book
formate.intro: DELF A1 has four papers (listening, reading, writing, speaking), each marked out of 25. As far as we could check, you need 50 out of 100 overall and at least 5 out of 25 in each paper; the diploma does not expire. Check the rule in the current regulations. To verify.

rows.what: Short recordings: understand information, short messages, announcements
Short everyday texts: signs, messages, adverts
Fill in a form; write a short message
Talk about yourself, exchange information, simple role play
rows.time: 5 to 7 minutes, plus about 10 minutes to prepare

formate.source: public exam information from France Éducation international (france-education-international.fr, DELF-DALF pages), checked on 11 November 2026. Treat timings and numbers of exercises as a guide and check the current official exam guide before you book
formate.intro: DELF A2 has four papers (listening, reading, writing, speaking), each marked out of 25. As far as we could check, you need 50 out of 100 overall and at least 5 out of 25 in each paper; the diploma does not expire. Check the rule in the current regulations. To verify.

rows.what: Short recordings on everyday situations: messages, announcements, a short radio item
Notices, adverts, messages, a short article or letter
Two short everyday messages: a letter or note to a friend, a formal message
Guided interview, exchange of information, role play
rows.time: 6 to 8 minutes, plus about 10 minutes to prepare

formate.source: public exam information from France Éducation international (france-education-international.fr, DELF-DALF pages), checked on 11 November 2026. Treat timings and numbers of exercises as a guide and check the current official exam guide before you book
formate.intro: DELF B1 has four papers (listening, reading, writing, speaking), each marked out of 25. As far as we could check, you need 50 out of 100 overall and at least 5 out of 25 in each paper; the diploma does not expire. Check the rule in the current regulations. To verify.

rows.what: An interview or news item, short documents, a longer document
A text to find information in; a text on a problem or opinions
An argued text expressing a personal opinion on a topic (article, forum post or letter)
Guided interview, interaction exercise (role play), expressing a point of view from a short text
rows.time: about 15 minutes, plus about 10 minutes to prepare

formate.source: public exam information from France Éducation international (france-education-international.fr, DELF-DALF pages), checked on 11 November 2026. Treat timings and numbers of exercises as a guide and check the current official exam guide before you book
formate.intro: DELF B2 has four papers (listening, reading, writing, speaking), each marked out of 25. As far as we could check, you need 50 out of 100 overall and at least 5 out of 25 in each paper; the diploma does not expire. Check the rule in the current regulations. To verify.

rows.what: An interview or debate, a radio report or a conference excerpt
A long informative text; an argued text
An argued text: a formal letter, an article or a text for an audience
A talk presenting and defending a point of view from a short document, then a discussion with the examiner
rows.time: about 20 minutes, plus about 30 minutes to prepare

formate.source: public exam information from France Éducation international (france-education-international.fr, DELF-DALF pages), checked on 11 November 2026. Treat timings and numbers of exercises as a guide and check the current official exam guide before you book
formate.intro: DALF C1 has four papers (listening, reading, writing, speaking), each marked out of 25. As far as we could check, you need 50 out of 100 overall and at least 5 out of 25 in each paper. The collective papers are taken together; the oral is taken separately. Check the current regulations. To verify.

rows.what: A longer document (a lecture or talk) and a radio extract
A long text of several pages: understanding the structure and the author's position
A synthesis of documents and an argued essay
A structured talk (exposé) on a subject drawn from documents, then a discussion with the examiners
rows.time: about 30 minutes, plus about 1 hour to prepare

formate.source: public exam information from France Éducation international (france-education-international.fr, DELF-DALF pages), checked on 11 November 2026. Treat timings and numbers of exercises as a guide and check the current official exam guide before you book
formate.intro: DALF C2 has two papers marked out of 50 points each: the collective papers (listening, reading and writing in one block) and the individual oral. As far as we could check, you need 50 out of 100 and at least 10 out of 50 in each. Check the current regulations. To verify. This course reaches C1; icanspeak French has no C2 practice set, only this format summary.

rows.what: Listening and reading comprehension, then a written task built on documents (the exact breakdown and timing: to verify)
A talk from a set of documents, then a discussion with the examiners
rows.time: about 30 minutes, plus about 1 hour to prepare (to verify)
